newsitem.title: USA: Telular Corp gets $20 million in credit.
newsitem.headline: Telular Corp gets $20 million in credit.

text.p: Telular Corp said it established a $20 million line of revolving credit with Sanwa Business Credit Corp, giving the company more flexibility to borrow.

"With the new credit facility, we are in a better position to meet the demands on working capital requirements associated with large Wireless Local Loop projects that the company is currently bidding on," president and chief executive Kenneth Millard, said in a statement dated April 23.
Telular said the line of credit follows its recent equity financing. It issued 10,000 preferred shares for about $10 million.
Telular said its product development and manufacturing consolidation plans are on target.

"We believe the market for Wireless Local Loop is experiencing substantial growth and Telular will devote the resources to meet the customer requirements in both analog and digital standards," Millard said.
